summary.text: 家 combines 宀, associated with a roof or dwelling, with a lower sign whose identity and role are disputed. Some analyses read the lower sign as a pig beneath a roof; the traditional account treats it as an abbreviated 豭 used for sound. Early dwelling and household uses are reported, while their sequence is unresolved. Today 家 commonly means house, home, or family.

formation.text: The construction is disputed. In an associative account, 宀 and a pig sign evoke livestock kept under a dwelling, with “pig enclosure” proposed as an original sense later extended or borrowed for human dwelling. The traditional Shuowen account instead treats 宀 as the dwelling element and the lower form as abbreviated 豭, a sound element. Matching readings make that sound analysis plausible if 豭 is the relevant element, but do not establish the identity or pronunciation of the earliest lower sign or prove a pig-enclosure origin.

components.text: 宀 contributes the roof or dwelling idea in the graph. It is present as a full component; the evidence does not propose a distinct earlier form.

The visible lower form is 豕. Some analyses interpret it as a pig contributing to a dwelling scene. The traditional account identifies it as abbreviated 豭 used for sound. Its identity and role in the earliest graph remain disputed; the proposed 𢑓 ancestor and alteration to 豕 are unverified.

sound_limitation.text: Readings support sound compatibility if 豭 is the relevant element, but do not establish that the visible 豕 represents 豭 or identify the earliest lower sign. No reading for proposed sign 𢑓 is established in this evidence.

history.text: Shuowen records the analysis 宀 plus abbreviated 豭 as a sound element; later regular script writes 豕 beneath 宀. This account does not establish that 豕 developed graphically from 豭.
A proposal that the earliest lower sign was 𢑓 and was later altered or misread as 豕 remains unverified; the reviewed evidence does not establish that graphic sequence.

uncertainties.text: The lower element’s earliest identity and role remain unsettled. Some accounts treat it as a pig in a dwelling scene; the traditional account treats it as an abbreviated sound element. “Pig enclosure” is a proposed original sense, not an established one.
Matching readings for 家 and 豭 do not prove that the earliest lower sign was named 豭. The evidence does not establish an ancient pronunciation for the proposed depicted animal or sign.

senses.period: Oracle-bone uses are reported; dates of individual examples are unresolved
senses.text: Human dwelling uses are reported in oracle-bone contexts. A pig-enclosure origin has been proposed, but the evidence does not establish it as the earliest meaning.

senses.gloss: ancestral temple, family, royal house or court, or counted household
senses.period: Oracle-bone and bronze uses are reported; sequence unresolved
senses.text: Reported uses include ancestral temple and family, royal house or court, and households counted as 家. Their sequence and relationships are unclear.
家 commonly means house or home, and also family. The chronology linking these senses to the reported early uses is not established here.

developments.text: Dwelling and household or institutional uses are both reported early, but their sequence and any development from one to the other remain unresolved.
The modern senses are established, but the evidence does not establish their chronology or transition from the reported early uses.

limitations.text: Reports of early uses do not provide a dated sequence of examined inscriptions, so the chronology of these senses remains unresolved.

The pig-enclosure account proposes a link from an enclosure to human dwelling; the traditional phonetic analysis offers a different account. Neither establishes the full history of the word’s meanings.

overview.text: 家 places 宀, a roof or dwelling element, over a disputed lower sign. Some interpret it as a pig, proposing a pig enclosure later used for human dwelling; the traditional account treats it as abbreviated 豭 for sound, though the earliest sign and its pronunciation are unverified.
